business_question: Risk that estimated market value falls by at least 25% within 24 months.
major_caveat: Market value is an estimate, not realized cash.
next_test: Run rolling-origin continuous change and threshold classification models.

business_question: Risk that a paid signing receives less than 10% of destination match-minute capacity over 24 months.
major_caveat: Measures sporting capital utilization, not tactical quality or accounting return.
next_test: Test paid-transfer under-utilization with market/profile, prior opportunity, and club context blocks.

business_question: Whether the disclosed acquisition fee is high or low relative to comparable player evidence.
major_caveat: Reported fee omits add-ons and undisclosed total deal costs.
next_test: Test rolling-origin log-fee prediction and comparable-transfer residuals.

business_question: Whether a paid signing both loses at least 25% estimated value and receives under 10% opportunity.
major_caveat: The joint severe-risk class is smaller than either component and needs class-balance checks.
next_test: Model component risks separately first, then test a calibrated joint-risk layer.

business_question: Conditional fee gain or loss when a later permanent sale has a disclosed positive fee.
primary_target: outbound fee / inbound fee among disclosed positive sales
major_caveat: Small, selected sample; zero/missing outbound fees are not equivalent to no proceeds.
next_test: Use descriptively or as a narrow secondary model, never as portfolio-wide ROI.

business_question: True accounting return after transfer costs, wages, bonuses, agent fees and book value.
major_caveat: Required cost and accounting fields do not exist in the current data.
next_test: Do not model or claim full ROI without licensed club accounting data.
